developers.title: Built for developers
developers.desc: Compatible with official SDKs; migration only takes a new base URL and key.

latency.title: Low-latency forwarding
latency.desc: Streaming responses are relayed chunk by chunk instead of being buffered in full.

billing.title: Pay as you go
billing.desc: No subscription and no monthly fee — usage-based charges with exportable statements.

editions.title: Three channels
editions.desc: Shared, Dedicated and Enterprise channels with different capacity and pricing.

failover.title: Automatic failover
failover.desc: Requests automatically retry on backup channels when an upstream fails.

organizations.title: Organizations and members
organizations.desc: Organizations top up centrally and assign quotas per member.

ratios.title: Public pricing
ratios.desc: Every model's price in each group is published on the pricing page.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.desc: Invoices for the Dedicated and Enterprise channels (not VAT invoices).

catalog.title: {count} models and counting
catalog.subtitle: New models are added as soon as they launch, with prices published alongside.

cta.title: Sign up and start building today
cta.subtitle: Personal and organization accounts are both welcome. Pay as you go and switch channels anytime.
